meta.title: What's new · Malondo
meta.desc: Everything Malondo gained, polished and fixed, version by version — from the first release in September 2026 to now.
title:
Page by page,
Malondo's own record book
lede: Since the first release on September 15, 2026, here is what each version added, polished and fixed. Newest first.
soon.note: Being prepared for the next update. The date appears once it's in the stores.
m.play.title: Now on Google Play
m.play.body: Android now grows alongside iPhone, with the same versions.
m.first.title: First release on the App Store
end: This record book gains a page with every update. If there's something you'd like, tell us on the Support page.
shot.alt.111: Malondo widgets on the home screen — a tear-off day, your temperature, and this month's decorated page
shot.alt.110: Home as a month-long record book
v.111.title: A page on your home screen — widgets become a record book
v.111.list:
• NewHome screen widgets, redrawn. “Today's page” turns like a tear-off calendar, and “This month's page” fits the whole month on one sheet, in medium and large.
  • NewThe paper, cover stickers, photos and handwriting you put on this month's page appear on the widget too.
  • NewIf today is still empty, pick a mood and a temperature right on the widget — no need to open the app. (iOS 17+ and Android)
  • NewPut this week and today's date on the Lock Screen. Your moods never show there. (iOS 16+)
  • NewWith Quiet mode on, the widget becomes a plain calendar with dates only.
  • NewDoodles you keep in the Sketchbook become white-bordered stickers, cut along your own lines. Voice ridges are cut out as mountains.
  • NewThe Tracing notebook is now manuscript paper. Write your own lines to trace, pick a nib and a typeface, and leave a note in the margin.
  • NewThe Jar of kind words is now a real-looking glass jar. Give it a shake and the paper stars tumble.
  • NewLetting go now has nine ways to fade and eight closing scenes, picked differently every time.
  • NewGentle fingertip hints show you a gesture the first time. Turn them off in Help.
  • ImprovedLong-press a day on the calendar to jump straight into decorating. You can now flip up to a year ahead.
  • ImprovedWhen AI or the internet isn't available, you'll see right away what you can do without AI.
  • ImprovedThe app now says plainly that phrase and letter counts don't refill each day.
  • FixedFixed text overflowing with large font sizes and on narrow screens.
  • FixedFixed the screen redrawing nonstop after a sound played, which used extra battery.
v.110.title: Home becomes a month-long record book
v.110.list:
• NewHome is now a month-long record book. Tap a date to open that day's page and decorate it with stickers and photos.
  • NewThe mood and speech temperature you left that day turn into stickers on their own.
  • NewGive stickers a sparkle or a gentle sway. If motion bothers you, turn it off under Display & sound.
  • NewPick shapes and colors for arrows, name tags and speech-bubble stickers.
  • NewSpread out the whole month to decorate it at once, and see your year on a single page.
  • ImprovedThe calendar turns like the pages of a book.
  • ImprovedOn the Window desk, the music box is now a snow globe and the candle sits in a window scene.
  • ImprovedTracing now lets you write one large character at a time.
  • ImprovedA brand-new guide for first-time users.
  • ImprovedAfter measuring, closing takes you back to where you were.
  • ImprovedStays light and smooth even with lots of records.
v.109.title: Days gone by, days to come
v.109.list:
• NewFill in a day's square for days that have passed — tap the date on the calendar for any you missed.
  • NewWrite down a mood for a day ahead. When that day comes, it's the first thing you see when you open the app.
  • ImprovedDays written in advance don't count toward your speech temperature until they arrive.
  • FixedIf the AI connection drops for a moment, it now reconnects without restarting the app.
v.108.title: Something to linger over on Home
v.108.list:
• NewScroll down Home for three pictures: “My warmth,” where your days stack up in the sky; a constellation of saved phrases; and paper lanterns rising for what you let go.
  • NewThe sky follows the time of day — dawn, morning, midday, dusk and evening light.
  • NewYour filled days color in one by one when you open Home, and today's square breathes slowly.
  • NewAfter you fill today's square, the rest of your day follows on a single page. At night, blow out a candle to close the day.
  • ImprovedSwipe from the left edge to close a screen.
  • ImprovedSwipe a saved phrase left to delete it — and undo right away.
  • ImprovedThe typeface and size you choose in Reading type now apply to all body text.
  • ImprovedThe music box's “month” now plays last month's song too.
  • FixedFixed month names under the calendar being cut off as “1…”.
v.107.title: Say hello to the Window desk
v.107.list:
• NewThe Window desk: a place to stay even on days you're not choosing words. Tracing, letters, a jar of kind words, a sketchbook, word flowers, a music box and a candle.
  • NewWhile you measure, your temperature is drawn on paper, and the result continues on that same page.
  • NewTap a date to see that day's measurements, saved phrases and what you made at the desk, all on one page.
  • NewHaptics and sounds now follow the temperature, and calm music plays in Take a break, Unwind and Letting go.
  • NewIn Letting go, you can draw instead of writing.
  • ImprovedExport files now carry your learned speaking style and settings, so a new phone picks up right where you left off.
  • FixedFixed haptics not working on iPhone while measuring.
v.106.title: A way back to the words you sent
v.106.list:
• NewCopy a suggested phrase and tap “Sent” — the next evening, one notification asks how it went.
  • NewUse it to reply, too: paste the message you received and find an answer together. The message isn't kept on your device.
  • NewLet a message cool for 20 minutes before sending. One notification tells you when time's up.
  • ImprovedNew line, light and watercolor illustrations for Home, the four steps, Unwind, Take a break and the end of Letting go.
  • ImprovedUnwind takes up to 300 characters, and the more you write, the more a tangled thread loosens into one strand.
  • ImprovedFirst-time users get a tour of everything on Home, one spot at a time.
  • FixedFixed text on Home's bottom cards being cut off in English, Japanese and Spanish.
v.105.title: The people around you — the People tab
v.105.list:
• NewThe Saved tab is now the People tab. See at a glance how warmly you've been speaking to the people gathered around you.
  • NewChoose which people you use in the Tone tab. Past records for anyone you turn off are hidden, not deleted.
  • NewChoose from five reading typefaces — Pretendard, MaruBuri, Gowun Batang, Gowun Dodum and Nanum Pen.
  • ImprovedSpeech temperature now centers on intonation, and a Voice reference (Default, Male, Female) fits it to your voice. It never leaves your device.
  • ImprovedA redesigned drawer shows your notification, language and reading-type settings at a glance, with Quiet mode one tap away.
  • ImprovedWarning signs are now noticed in English, Japanese and Spanish too, and outside Korea you're pointed to local emergency numbers.
v.104.title: Now in four languages
v.104.list:
• New한국어, English, 日本語 and Español — both the screens and the phrases Malondo writes come in your language.
  • NewChoose ℃ or °F. Switching units never changes your past records.
  • NewA new “Who you spoke with” card on Home. People you haven't spoken to yet show “not yet,” not zero.
  • ImprovedThe tone fingerprint keeps all five axes even when intonation wasn't heard. Home spacing, calendar squares, the record button and dial got a polish.
v.103.title: A short scene after letting go
v.103.list:
• NewWhen letting go ends, one of seven short scenes plays, and a few comforting words slowly appear.
  • ImprovedSmoother screen transitions and visual effects.
v.102.title: Getting ready to tell you about updates
v.102.list:
• ImprovedThe version shown in the app now matches the store.
  • NewThe app can now let you know when a new version is out. Nothing is sent to check — it fetches one version table and compares on your device.
v.101.title: Fixed “Leave today”
v.101.list: • FixedFixed “Leave today →” under the Home calendar doing nothing when tapped, and made it easier to hit.
v.100.title: Malondo's first release
v.100.list:
• NewWhat to say — choose who, what you want to do and a temperature, describe what happened, and get four phrases in different tones.
  • NewUnwind first — write what you couldn't tell anyone and receive a letter.
  • NewLetting go — write something that lingers in 100 characters and rub it away by hand. Nothing you write is kept.
  • NewMeasure your speech temperature — speak for about 20 seconds and see how close you came to the warmth you aimed for. The recording is deleted right away.
  • NewOne square a day, the Home calendar, a daily phrase, and a home screen widget.
